task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5 (registry lookup) + Step 1 (diagnose) for ISS-0896, combined into this one dispatch since both are your own role's sequential work. Step 0.5: grep docs/issues/*.yaml for a status: resolved entry with matching symptoms (hardcoded Keycloak credentials in web/tests/e2e specs) -- report whether a prior match exists (none is expected; this is the first hardening of these particular specs). Step 1: this is a description-only issue (no failing test to run -- these e2e specs require a live Playwright browser + backend + Keycloak to execute at all, and this run has no such live QA/staging environment). Read docs/issues/ISS-0896.yaml's full description, then read all 5 occurrences directly (grep 'admin-cli' across the 4 named files -- env04.e2e.spec.ts has 2, the other 3 have 1 each) to confirm the exact code shape and whether all 5 are structurally identical or differ in a way that matters for the fix design (e.g. different surrounding context, different variable names for the master URL, whether keycloakMasterUrl/BPM_IDP_BASE_URL is already parameterized elsewhere in each file). Also check whether web/ already has an established env-var-reading convention for test config (grep web/tests/e2e/ and web/playwright.config.ts or similar for existing process.env.* usage patterns) so the fix's approach is consistent with what's already there rather than inventing a new one. Do NOT implement the fix.
